This activation increase implies enhanced executive function, captured by 'cognitive_rehabilitation_efficiency', which measures normalized cognitive gains per unit time, adjusted for measurement noise. The 'social_integration_metric' reflects the inverse relationship between social withdrawal and rehabilitative progress. These primitives form a dual framework where neurophysiological recovery supports behavioral reintegration. Failure modes include insufficient activation thresholds, high noise variance, or persistent social disengagement. Dualities arise from the symmetry between neural activation and behavioral outcomes, suggesting a closed-loop feedback mechanism in rehabilitation systems.
